name: pn5180
title: NXP PN5180
notes: Drives an antenna of its own choice: the range is that of the antenna, see the modules.
The chip sets no limit of cards at once: 14 is the scan of the library, for ISO14443A.
tx_mw_max is the supply of the transmitter, TVDD 5.5 V at 250 mA. The datasheet gives no radiated power.
draw is the current on pin TVDD alone when the field is on, and the standby current.

facts.source: PN5180A0XX_C3_C4.pdf Rev. 4.0, features and quick reference data
